$description: RadarChart (platform/charts/RadarChart.jsx, library wave 9, lane B): its component tokens. Spokes, rings, outlines and points are the frame's (chart-*); these set the area's opacity, the points and the measures' names. No new color: existing roles and the theme's opacity scale.

radar-chart-area-opacity.$description: Radar chart: an item's area is its data color at this opacity, so overlapping shapes stay visible.

radar-chart-point-radius.$description: Radar chart: the radius of a value's point (the frame's point, with its ring).

radar-chart-label-offset.$description: Radar chart: the distance between a spoke's end and the measure's name, and between a ring and its value.

radar-chart-axis-label-text.$description: Radar chart: a measure's name at the end of its spoke.

radar-chart-axis-label-font-family.$description: Radar chart: the measures' names are UI text: the label font.

radar-chart-axis-label-font-size.$description: Radar chart: a measure's name's size.

radar-chart-axis-label-font-weight.$description: Radar chart: a measure's name's weight.
